mentions.name: Horizon viewer app
mentions.description: This app informs the user what is on the horizon when looking out into the distance, including ships at sea and planes in the sky, built with OSM data, open APIs, and simple math.
mentions.source_excerpt: 4. (stretch) I would love an app where I could look out into the distance, and be informed what's on the horizon. Likewise ships in the sea / planes in the sky. I think it's doable with some OSM data, open APIs and a bit of high school math
